name: Ford FE V8 (332 / 352 / 360 / 390 / 406 / 427 / 428)
description: Ford's FE big block, 1958-76: the Thunderbird 352 and 390s, the 406 and 427 high-performance engines with their dual quads and 3x2s, the 428 Police Interceptor and Cobra Jet, and the 427's Weber cross-ram race induction; the Toploader, the Borg-Warner T-10, the Cruise-O-Matic and the C6. All drawn from solids.

builds.engine: Ford 427 side-oiler dual quad 425 hp (1965 Shelby Cobra 427)
Ford 428 Police Interceptor dual quad 355 hp (1967 Shelby GT500)
Ford 428 Cobra Jet Ram Air 335 hp (1969 Shelby GT500)
Ford 428 Cobra Jet 335 hp (1970 Mustang Mach 1)
Ford 428 Super Cobra Jet 335 hp (1970, Drag Pack)
Ford 427 Weber cross-ram race engine with headers (GT40 Mk II)
Ford 428 Cobra Jet crate engine with headers
